question: Can an otherwise identical binary preference task declare class 0 as positive under accuracy and still get a genuine adviser election? The released controller admitted the task, reserved its research budget, then fell back without trying the adviser when the class order was [1,0].
training_replay: On the three matched panels from the frozen 710 election, permute every class-probability column with its class name. Require the primary nomination and both confirmation counts to equal the sealed records in both orders. Truth and training groups remain identical. This replay requires zero fits and never opens evaluation labels.
ordinary_entry: Create an anonymous copy of the existing film development training packet with only positive_label=0 inserted in the manifest. Prove identical training CSV bytes and prediction input. Use the same full encoder directory, 16-fit limit, time limit 1800, no model or policy flag. After refitting and separate-process prediction, compare actions, advice and prediction file with the pre-existing ordinary movie experiment. Report changes including ties; differences can originate elsewhere in the scheduler. This is an input-contract check on known public development rows, not another independent performance benchmark.
limits: Up to 16 new local supervised fits. No model API, course validation, movie scoring labels, test or H2 reads. Keep the original release and package intact.
